title: Responsive matrix smoke on delivered pages
objective: Verify delivered pages (login, dashboard, asset register, detail, create/edit, 403/404) render without page-level horizontal scroll and with correct layout mode at the design breakpoints.
preconditions: UI running; operator signed in; Playwright viewport emulation.
steps: For each viewport: load /login, /, /assets, /assets/<uuid>, /assets/new.
Assert document scrollWidth <= viewport width (no horizontal scroll).
Verify layout mode: bottom nav on mobile, icon rail/drawer on tablet, sidebar on desktop.
Capture a screenshot per page per viewport into evidence.
expected_result: No horizontal scrolling at any size including 320px; correct navigation pattern per breakpoint; content readable; touch targets >=44x44px on compact sizes; dialogs become full-screen sheets on mobile.

title: Asset register table-to-card responsive switch
objective: Verify the register renders a sortable table with sticky header on desktop and cards with key fields + action menu on mobile, with pagination adapting (numbered vs prev/next).
steps: At 1440px: verify table, sortable column headers, sticky header on scroll, numbered pagination.
At 375px: verify card list shows tag, name, status badge, category/model, custodian/location, action menu; pagination is prev/next; filters open in a bottom sheet with Apply/Clear always visible.
expected_result: Both modes render correctly with equivalent data and actions; no content cut off; filter sheet usable at 320px.

title: Automated axe accessibility scan on delivered pages
objective: Run axe-core against all Cycle-1 pages at desktop and mobile widths; zero critical/serious violations.
preconditions: UI running; axe-core integrated in Playwright (or run via @axe-core/playwright).
steps: For each page (authenticated where required), run axe at 1440px and 375px.
Record all violations by impact; save JSON + screenshots to evidence.
expected_result: 0 critical and 0 serious violations on every page/width; moderate/minor violations logged as defects with severity assessment.

title: Keyboard-only pass — sign-in, register list, asset detail
objective: Verify complete keyboard operability: skip link, logical tab order, visible focus, no traps, Escape closes overlays with focus restore.
steps: From /login: Tab from page load — skip link appears first and works; complete sign-in without mouse.
On /assets: tab through nav, filters, table rows, pagination; activate a row via Enter.
On asset detail: navigate tabs/history by keyboard.
Open any dialog/menu; press Escape; verify close + focus restored to trigger.
Verify active nav item has aria-current.
expected_result: Every interactive element reachable and operable by keyboard; focus indicator visible on all surfaces (dark theme); no keyboard traps; Escape behavior correct; aria-current present on active nav item.
automation_status: partially automatable (Playwright keyboard); manual confirmation recommended

title: Dark theme token contrast spot check
objective: Verify the layout §5.2 palette pairings used for text/background meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large/UI) and tokens are referenced semantically.
preconditions: UI running; computed styles accessible via Playwright; token list from design §7.
test_data: pairings: text #F3F6FA on canvas #090D14 and surface #121A26; secondary #B8C4D1 on surface; muted #8795A6 on surface; accent #5EA2FF on canvas; danger #FF6B78 on surface; focus ring #8CC8FF visibility
steps: Sample computed color/background-color of representative elements (body text, secondary text, muted metadata, links/buttons, badges, focus ring).
Compute contrast ratios programmatically.
Verify status badges pair icon+text (not color alone) for at least 3 statuses.
expected_result: All sampled text pairings >= 4.5:1 (or >=3:1 for large text/UI components); focus ring clearly visible; statuses distinguishable without color; components use semantic tokens (spot-check built CSS/DOM for absence of hardcoded hex in component styles where feasible).

title: No flash of unstyled/light theme on load
objective: Verify SSR color-scheme bootstrap prevents a light flash: initial HTML carries dark class/color-scheme before hydration.
preconditions: UI running; hard refresh with cache disabled.
steps: Fetch the SSR HTML of /login and / (pre-hydration) and inspect <html> attributes and head bootstrap script.
Record page load with Playwright video/screenshots at early timestamps.
expected_result: SSR HTML includes class='dark' (or equivalent) and inline color-scheme/bootstrap script in head; no light background painted at any point during load.

title: Error pages 403/404/error are accessible and on-theme
objective: Verify error pages render within the shell, use user-safe messages, offer a way back, and pass keyboard/axe checks.
test_data: navigate to /nonexistent-route; employee navigating to /assets/new (403); forced error state if feasible
steps: Visit each error page; verify content, landmarks, and recovery action (link/button).
Run axe on each; tab through each.
expected_result: Clear, user-safe messaging; recovery navigation present and keyboard-accessible; no stack traces; dark theme applied; axe clean.

title: App shell structure and navigation per layout spec
objective: Verify shell composition: desktop persistent collapsible sidebar + top bar (page context, global search, quick-create, profile); mobile top bar + bottom nav with drawer for secondary items; breadcrumbs on nested desktop pages.
steps: Desktop: verify sidebar items per role, collapse/expand persists during session, top bar elements present, breadcrumbs on /assets/<uuid>.
Mobile: verify bottom nav (Home, Assets, Scan, Tasks, More) with More opening drawer of secondary items; Scan/Tasks stubs show accessible 'coming soon' empty states rather than broken pages.
expected_result: Shell matches design §6 navigation spec at each breakpoint; stubbed Cycle-2 destinations render deliberate empty states (not 404/500); active section indicated visually and programmatically.

title: Loading/empty states use skeletons and helpful empty content
objective: Verify loading skeletons (not spinners-only) on register/detail/dashboard and designed empty states with next-step guidance.
preconditions: UI running; ability to throttle network (Playwright) and to produce empty result sets.
test_data: throttled network; filter combination matching zero assets
steps: Load pages under throttled network; capture skeleton rendering.
Apply a filter yielding zero results; capture empty state.
Verify live-region announcement of loading completion for screen readers (aria-live presence).
expected_result: Skeletons mirror layout; empty states include icon/text + suggested action (e.g., clear filters); dynamic updates announced via live regions; no layout shift surprises.
